stories.title: Unions react as Welsh Government confirms teachers’ pay rise below recommended 4.25%
stories.summary: Teaching unions have accused the Welsh Government of disregarding independent pay recommendations with strikes potentially looming in Flintshire and Wrexham. stories.title: Childline warns of summer spike in children seeking body image support
stories.summary: Childline is warning of a likely summer spike in children seeking support for body image concerns.
